subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

The angle of repose is the angle a freely formed stable granular pile surface makes with the horizontal under stated test conditions.

Explanation

  • For an approximately conical pile, tanθ=h/r. State pouring method, moisture and whether static/dynamic; results depend on the test.
  • Shape, size distribution, roughness, moisture and cohesion affect flowability and angle.
  • It does not alone determine hopper wall angle or guarantee mass flow. Wall friction and cohesive strength require separate tests.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નિર્ધારિત testમાં freely formed stable granular pileની surface horizontal સાથે બનાવે તે angle of repose.

સમજણ

  • લગભગ conical pileમાં tanθ=h/r. Pouring method, moisture/static-dynamic test જણાવો.
  • Shape, size distribution, roughness, moisture/cohesionથી flowability/angle બદલાય.
  • આ એકલા hopper angle/mass flow નક્કી ન કરે; wall friction/cohesive strengthના અલગ tests જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Bulk storage holds loose particulate material; bins/silos are enclosed storage vessels with defined filling and discharge arrangements.

Classification

  • Stockpiles may be open/covered. Bins are commonly shorter/wider, silos taller/slender, but terminology is not a universal dimensional rule.
  • Mass flow moves the whole bed toward discharge; funnel flow has a moving channel with stagnant surrounding zones.

Explanation

  • Construction includes filling point, body, level indication, vent/dust control, hopper, outlet and suitable feeder/supports.
  • Arching bridges an outlet; ratholing leaves a stable stagnant annulus. Segregation may occur during filling/discharge.
  • Choose geometry/material/feeder from tested powder properties, load and safety requirements; bulk volume=M/ρb is only an inventory estimate.

Limitations and safety

  • No silo entry, walking on stored solids, poking live outlets or compressed-air clearing. Burial and dust explosion are severe hazards.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Loose particulate materialનો સંગ્રહ bulk storage; bin/siloમાં defined filling/dischargeવાળું enclosed vessel હોય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Stockpile open/covered હોઈ શકે. Bin સામાન્ય રીતે ટૂંકું/પહોળું, silo ઊંચું/slender; universal dimensional rule નથી.
  • Mass flowમાં આખો bed discharge તરફ ખસે; funnel flowમાં moving channel આસપાસ stagnant zones.

સમજણ

  • Filling point, body, level indicator, vent/dust control, hopper, outlet તથા feeder/supports મુખ્ય ભાગો.
  • Arching outlet bridge કરે; ratholingમાં stagnant annulus રહે. Filling/dischargeમાં segregation થઈ શકે.
  • Tested powder properties, load/safety પરથી geometry/material/feeder પસંદ કરો; M/ρb માત્ર inventory volume estimate.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Silo entry, stored solid પર ચાલવું, live outlet poke કે compressed-air clearing નહીં. Burial/dust explosion ગંભીર.

body.en:
Definition

A conveyor whose rotating helical flight advances solids in a trough/tube.

Principle

  • Flight motion and friction with the stationary enclosure produce axial material transport.

Construction—detailed theory

A screw conveyor encloses a helical flight fixed to a shaft (2) inside a trough or tube (1). Bearings and supports (3) carry the shaft, while a guarded motor and gearbox (4) provide rotation. The inlet (5) admits material to the flight spaces and an outlet (6) removes it at the intended location.

Flight diameter, pitch, trough clearance and allowable fill are selected together. The enclosure supports the solids and limits spillage, but a cover must not be removed while the screw can move. Horizontal service is common; incline changes capacity and slip, so a horizontal capacity assumption cannot be transferred unchanged to every inclination.

Working—detailed theory

Metered feed enters the spaces between successive flights. Rotation causes the sloping flight surface to exert an axial force on the solids. Friction with the stationary trough restrains simple co-rotation of the whole bed, allowing relative motion that advances material along the conveyor. If the material only turned with the screw, little useful axial transport would occur.

Successive flight sections transfer material towards the outlet, where it drops out for further handling. Actual throughput depends on filled volume, pitch, speed, bulk density and slip; the theoretical displaced volume is not automatically the delivered rate. Sticky material, overfilling or unsuitable large lumps can cause blockage and excessive torque. Clearing requires complete isolation, not an open running cover.

Applications

  • Short enclosed powder/granular transfer and metering in suitable service.

Limitations and safety

  • Can damage fragile solids and suffer wear/blockage; no open cover or live clearing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Trough/tubeમાં rotating helical flightથી solids આગળ ખસે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Flight motion તથા stationary enclosureની frictionથી axial transport થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Screw conveyorમાં trough/tube (1)ની અંદર shaft સાથે helical flight (2) હોય છે. Bearings/supports (3) shaftને ટેકો આપે; guarded motor/gearbox (4) rotation આપે. Inlet (5)થી material flight spacesમાં આવે અને intended locationના outlet (6)થી જાય.

Flight diameter, pitch, clearance/allowable fill સાથે પસંદ થાય. Enclosure solidsને ટેકો આપી spillage ઘટાડે; screw move કરી શકે ત્યારે cover ખોલવું નહીં. Horizontal service સામાન્ય છે; inclineથી capacity/slip બદલાય એટલે horizontal capacityને દરેક inclination માટે સમાન ન માનવી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Metered feed consecutive flights વચ્ચે આવે છે. Rotationથી sloping flight surface solids પર axial force આપે છે. Stationary troughનું friction આખા bedનું co-rotation રોકે એટલે relative motionથી material આગળ જાય. માત્ર screw સાથે material ફરતું રહે તો useful axial transport ઓછું મળે.

Successive flights materialને outlet તરફ લઈ જાય જ્યાં તે નીચે જાય. Actual throughput filled volume, pitch, speed, bulk density/slip પર આધારિત છે; theoretical displaced volume એટલે delivered rate નહીં. Sticky feed, overfill/large lumpsથી blockage/torque વધે. Clearing સંપૂર્ણ isolation પછી જ; running cover ખોલીને નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

  • Short enclosed powder/granular transfer/metering.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Fragile solids તૂટે, wear/blockage; open cover/live clearing નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An endless moving belt carrying material between loading and discharge points.

Principle

  • Pulley traction moves the belt; material is carried by belt support/friction.

Construction—detailed theory

An endless flexible belt (1) runs around a drive pulley and tail pulley (2). Carrying idlers support the loaded run and return idlers support the empty run (3). A take-up arrangement maintains suitable tension (4). The loading chute and skirts place material centrally on the belt (5), while the head region provides the discharge path and cleaner where specified (6).

The supporting structure maintains alignment along the route, and guards protect pulley nips and drives. Belt width, speed, troughing and permitted inclination are selected for the bulk material. The belt is the carrying surface; the idlers mainly support and guide it rather than independently pushing each particle along the route.

Working—detailed theory

The motor turns the drive pulley, and traction between pulley and tensioned belt moves the endless loop. Feed lands centrally on the carrying run and is transported with the belt, provided the load remains stable. Idlers support the moving belt and limit sag; suitable feeding reduces off-centre loading, spillage and tracking problems.

At the head pulley the belt turns onto its return run, while material continues along its discharge trajectory into the chute. The empty belt returns to the loading point and the take-up maintains the required tension. Capacity depends on load cross-section, speed and bulk density, not belt speed alone. Excess inclination can cause rollback or slipping even if the motor has adequate power.

Applications

  • Continuous high-throughput transport of bulk solids over suitable routes.

Limitations and safety

  • Spillage, dust, tracking and incline limits matter. No riding or reaching into pulley nips.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Loading/discharge વચ્ચે material વહન કરતો endless moving belt.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Pulley tractionથી belt ફરે; support/frictionથી material વહે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Endless flexible belt (1) drive/tail pulleys (2) પર ફરે છે. Carrying idlers loaded run અને return idlers empty runને ટેકો આપે (3). Take-up (4) suitable tension રાખે. Loading chute/skirts (5) material centreમાં મૂકે; head regionમાં discharge તથા specified cleaner (6) હોય છે.

Supporting structure routeમાં alignment જાળવે અને guards pulley nips/drives ઢાંકે. Material મુજબ width, speed, troughing/inclination પસંદ થાય. Belt carrying surface છે; idlers તેને support/guide કરે, દર particleને સ્વતંત્ર આગળ ધકેલતા નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Motor drive pulley ફેરવે; pulley તથા tensioned beltના tractionથી endless loop ચાલે. Feed carrying runના centreમાં આવી stable load તરીકે belt સાથે જાય. Idlers support આપી sag ઘટાડે; યોગ્ય feedingથી off-centre loading, spillage/tracking problems ઘટે.

Head pulley પર belt return runમાં વળે, જ્યારે material discharge trajectoryથી chuteમાં જાય. Empty belt loading pointએ પાછો આવે; take-up tension રાખે. Capacity load cross-section, speed/bulk density પર છે, માત્ર speed પર નહીં. વધુ inclineથી adequate motor power હોવા છતાં rollback/slip થઈ શકે.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય route પર continuous વધુ-throughput bulk transport.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Spillage, dust, tracking/incline limits; belt પર ચડવું કે pulley nipમાં પહોંચવું નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An enclosed elevator carrying bulk solids upward in buckets attached to a belt/chain.

Principle

  • Positive bucket support lifts solids; discharge may be centrifugal or gravity/continuous by design.

Construction—detailed theory

Buckets fixed to an endless belt or chain (2) travel inside a tall protective casing with a lower boot (1). Head and boot wheels guide the loop (3), while a guarded drive at the head supplies motion (4). Feed enters the boot through a designed inlet (5), and a separate upper chute collects the discharged material (6).

Bucket shape, spacing, filling method and speed are matched to the intended centrifugal or gravity/continuous discharge mode. The casing provides containment and the boot includes designed access for isolated maintenance. It is not a passenger lift or an open series of cups for live hand filling; moving bucket, chain and wheel regions require guarding.

Working—detailed theory

At the boot, buckets receive material by the designed feed or digging method without being overloaded. The belt or chain carries the filled buckets upward, supplying the lifting work. The load remains supported in individual buckets during the ascent, so the machine is useful for predominantly vertical movement of compatible bulk solids.

At the head the change in direction produces the design-specific discharge: a suitable high-speed arrangement throws material into the chute, while a continuous/gravity design transfers it differently at lower speed. Empty buckets descend on the return side and reload at the boot. Incorrect speed or discharge geometry may cause backlegging, so the two discharge modes must not be treated as interchangeable settings.

Applications

  • Vertical lifting of suitable granular/powder solids.

Limitations and safety

  • Backlegging, plugging and dust hazards; no live boot access or improvised overspeed operation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Belt/chainના bucketsથી bulk solid ઉપર લઈ જતું enclosed elevator.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Bucket supportથી lift; design મુજબ centrifugal કે gravity/continuous discharge.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Endless belt/chain સાથેના buckets (2) tall protective casing/lower boot (1)માં ચાલે છે. Head/boot wheels (3) loop guide કરે; head પર guarded drive (4) હોય છે. Designed boot inlet (5)થી feed આવે અને upper chute (6) discharge લે છે.

Bucket shape, spacing, filling/speed centrifugal કે gravity/continuous discharge મુજબ match થાય છે. Casing containment આપે; boot access માત્ર isolated maintenance માટે છે. આ passenger lift કે live hand-filling cups નથી; moving bucket, chain/wheel regions guarded રહેવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Bootમાં designed feed/digging methodથી buckets overfill વિના ભરાય. Belt/chain ભરેલા buckets ઉપર લઈ જઈ lifting work આપે. Ascentમાં individual buckets loadને ટેકો આપે; તેથી compatible solidsના mainly vertical movement માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

Head પર direction બદલાતાં design-specific discharge મળે: suitable higher-speed design material chuteમાં throw કરે; continuous/gravity design lower speedએ જુદી રીતે transfer કરે. Empty buckets return sideથી નીચે આવી ફરી ભરે. Wrong speed/geometryથી backlegging થાય; બંને modesને interchangeable settings ન માનવા.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય granular/powder solidનું vertical lifting.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Backlegging, plugging/dust hazards; live boot access/overspeed નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A system transporting suitable solids in a gas stream through enclosed piping.

Classification

  • Classify positive-pressure/vacuum and dilute/dense-phase systems; the sketch is positive-pressure dilute-phase concept.

Principle

  • Gas momentum/pressure gradient overcomes transport resistance; solid loading and flow regime govern operation.

Construction—detailed theory

The illustrated positive-pressure system has a suitable gas source (1), controlled solids feeder or airlock (2) and enclosed conveying pipeline with selected bends (3). The pipe terminates at a receiver/separator (4), followed by a final gas filter or controlled vent arrangement (5). A designed outlet removes separated solids (6).

Feeder and receiver arrangements must limit unwanted leakage across pressure boundaries. Pipe diameter, route and materials are selected for the required loading and particle properties. Vacuum and dense-phase systems use different arrangements and flow conditions; the same simple dilute-phase picture cannot specify their operating pressures, velocities or controls.

Working—detailed theory

The gas source establishes a pressure difference and gas flow through the enclosed line. Metered solids enter through the approved feeder and are accelerated by momentum transfer from the gas. In the illustrated dilute-phase concept, particles are carried mainly in suspension through the pipe; the pressure gradient must overcome line, bend and solids-transport resistance.

At the receiver, the solids are separated from the carrier gas and discharged through the controlled outlet. Residual dust is retained by the final filtration system before gas leaves by the designed route. Transport requires an appropriate flow regime: insufficient transport can block the pipe, while excessive velocity can increase attrition, erosion and energy use. No powder should be blown into an occupied room as a demonstration.

Applications

  • Enclosed transfer of compatible powders/granules between storage/process points.

Limitations and safety

  • Erosion, attrition, pressure loss, blockage and dust explosion risks require engineering. No homemade dust-blowing or pressure-line model.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Enclosed pipeમાં gas streamથી યોગ્ય solidsનું transport.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Positive-pressure/vacuum તથા dilute/dense-phase જુદાં; drawing positive-pressure dilute-phase concept.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Gas momentum/pressure gradientથી resistance હરાય; solid loading/flow regime મહત્વનાં.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

દર્શાવેલા positive-pressure systemમાં suitable gas source (1), controlled feeder/airlock (2), enclosed pipeline/selected bends (3), receiver/separator (4), final gas filter/controlled vent (5) તથા solids outlet (6) હોય છે.

Feeder/receiver pressure boundaries પર unwanted leakage મર્યાદિત રાખે. Required loading/particle properties પ્રમાણે diameter, route/materials પસંદ થાય. Vacuum/dense-phase systemsનાં arrangements/conditions જુદાં છે; આ dilute-phase pictureથી તેમના pressure, velocity કે controls નક્કી ન કરવા.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Gas source pressure difference તથા enclosed lineમાં flow બનાવે. Approved feederથી metered solids આવી gas momentum transferથી accelerate થાય. દર્શાવેલા dilute-phase conceptમાં particles મુખ્યત્વે suspensionમાં વહે; pressure gradient line, bends/solids resistance હરાવે છે.

Receiverમાં solids carrier gasથી અલગ થઈ controlled outletથી જાય. Final filter residual dust રોકે પછી gas designed routeથી નીકળે. યોગ્ય regime જરૂરી:અપૂરતો transport pipe block કરે; વધુ velocityથી attrition, erosion/energy વધે. Demonstration માટે occupied roomમાં powder blow ન કરવો.

ઉપયોગો

  • Storage/process વચ્ચે compatible powders/granulesનું enclosed transfer.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Erosion, attrition, pressure loss, blockage/dust explosion માટે engineering. Homemade dust-blowing/pressure-line model નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Measured dry cone height h=0.25m and base radius r=0.50m.

To find

Find angle of repose from cone height and radius.

Governing relation and assumptions

The cone cross-section gives tanθ=h/r, where θ is measured from the horizontal and r is base radius.

Calculation with substitution

  1. tanθ=h/r=0.50; θ=tan⁻¹0.5=26.565°.
  2. Use radius, not diameter; state moisture and measurement method.
  3. This number alone does not set a safe silo hopper angle; wall friction and cohesive flow tests matter.

Final answer

θ=tan⁻¹(0.25/0.50)=26.565°.

Unit/physical check

h/r is dimensionless.Use radius, not diameter; angle of repose alone is not sufficient for safe silo-hopper design.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

Dry cone height h=0.25m, base radius r=0.50m.

શું શોધવું

Cone height/radiusથી angle of repose શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

Cone cross-sectionમાં tanθ=h/r; θ horizontalથી અને r base radius છે.

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. tanθ=0.50; θ=26.565°.
  2. Radius લો, diameter નહીં; moisture/measurement method જણાવો.
  3. માત્ર આ valueથી silo hopper angle નક્કી નહીં; wall friction/cohesive flow tests જરૂરી.

અંતિમ જવાબ

θ=tan⁻¹(0.25/0.50)=26.565°.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

h/r નિરેક છે.Radius લો, diameter નહીં; માત્ર repose angleથી safe silo-hopper design ન થાય.

title.en: Practical 16: Conveyor comparison OR working model
title.gu: પ્રયોગ 16: Conveyor Comparison અથવા Working Model

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Complete one suggested practical:comparison chart OR instructor-approved low-energy working model, not two separate official practicals.

Instruments/materials

  • Option A:equipment diagrams and verified specifications. Option B:instructor-approved guarded low-voltage model, benign sample, ruler, timer and balance.

Connections/setup

  • Choose screw, belt, bucket or pneumatic concept with instructor. For a model enclose all nips/drives; no homemade pressurised powder circuit.

Procedure

  1. Option A:draw labelled parts and compare transport direction, material suitability, capacity basis, dust, damage, maintenance and hazards.
  2. Option B:submit sketch/risk check for instructor approval before assembly; build only the approved low-energy guarded design.
  3. For an approved model, demonstrate operation at fixed safe settings and record genuine transported mass/time, not design claims.
  4. Stop and isolate before any adjustment; submit either completed chart or the approved model record with limitations.

Blank observation sheet

  • Chart blanks:type ___, parts ___, principle ___, material ___, route ___, capacity reference ___, advantages ___, limitations ___, safety ___.
  • Model blanks:approved design ___, guard check ___, mass ___kg, time ___s, speed ___, spillage ___kg, observations ___.

Calculations and blank result

  • If measured, Q=m/t on the stated basis; result ___kg/s. Chart conclusion:most suitable option for specified duty ___ because ___.
  • No fixed report-page count or compulsory separate project is stated in this syllabus.

Safe fault-finding

  • After isolation inspect model tracking, loose fasteners, obstruction or feed overloading; staff approves repair before rerun.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.
  • No exposed screw/chain, belt riding, bucket access or powder blowing; prefer chart if safe model facilities are absent.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા મર્યાદા

  • એક suggested practical:comparison chart અથવા instructor-approved low-energy model; બે official practicals નહીં.

સાધનો/પદાર્થો

  • Option A:diagrams/verified specifications. Option B:approved guarded low-voltage model, benign sample, ruler, timer/balance.

જોડાણ/ગોઠવણ

  • Instructor સાથે screw, belt, bucket/pneumatic concept પસંદ; modelમાં nips/drives enclose; homemade pressurised powder circuit નહીં.

કાર્યક્રમ

  1. Option A:labelled parts; direction, suitability, capacity basis, dust, damage, maintenance/hazards compare.
  2. Option B:assembly પહેલાં sketch/risk check approval; approved low-energy guarded design જ.
  3. Approved modelમાં fixed safe settings; genuine transported mass/time, design claims નહીં.
  4. Adjustment પહેલાં stop/isolate; chart અથવા model record/limitations submit.

ખાલી અવલોકન પત્રક

  • Chart blanks:type ___, parts ___, principle ___, material ___, route ___, capacity reference ___, advantages ___, limits ___, safety ___.
  • Model blanks:approved design ___, guard check ___, mass ___kg, time ___s, speed ___, spillage ___kg, observations ___.

ગણતરી તથા ખાલી પરિણામ

  • માપ્યું હોય તો stated basis પર Q=m/t; result ___kg/s. Chart conclusion:specified duty માટે option ___, કારણ ___.
  • આ syllabusમાં fixed report pages કે અલગ compulsory project આપેલ નથી.

સલામત Fault-Finding

  • Isolation પછી tracking, fasteners, obstruction/overload; rerun પહેલાં staff repair approval.

સાવચેતીઓ

  • Instructor-approved guarded trainer તથા compatible nonhazardous sample જ; apparatus ID/authorised settings લખો.
  • ખોલતાં, adjust/clear કરતાં પહેલાં electrical/mechanical/pressure energy isolate કરો; emergency stop isolation નથી.
  • નિર્ધારિત PPE, dust/spill control તથા laboratory waste procedure અનુસરો; live fault test improvisation નહીં.
  • Exposed screw/chain, belt riding, bucket access/powder blowing નહીં; safe facilities ન હોય તો chart પસંદ.

body.en:
Which density includes interparticle void volume? A particle B bulk C fluid

B:bulk density uses the whole bed volume.

Bond sizes in the conventional equation are:A μm B metres C arbitrary mixed units

A:μm, with matching work-index energy/ton basis.

Screen overall effectiveness here is:A rC+rF B rC×rF C capacity

B:product of coarse and fine recoveries under the stated definition.

Stokes settling requires:A Re≪1 B any Re C a thick concentrated bed

A:dilute isolated sphere with low Reynolds number and stated assumptions.

Agitator N in P=NpρN³D⁵ is:A rpm B rev/s C rad/s

B:rev/s; divide rpm by60.

Repose θ is measured from:A horizontal B vertical C shaft

A:horizontal; tanθ=h/r.
body.gu:
Interparticle void volume કઈ densityમાં? A particle B bulk C fluid

B:bulk density આખું bed volume લે છે.

Conventional Bond equationમાં sizes:A μm B metres C mixed units

A:μm તથા matching work-index energy/ton basis.

અહીં Screen Overall Effectiveness:A rC+rF B rC×rF C capacity

B:stated definition મુજબ coarse/fine recoveriesનો ગુણાકાર.

Stokes Settling માટે:A Re≪1 B any Re C thick concentrated bed

A:dilute isolated sphere, low Reynolds તથા stated assumptions.

P=NpρN³D⁵માં N:A rpm B rev/s C rad/s

B:rev/s; rpmને60થી ભાગો.

Repose θ કોનાથી? A horizontal B vertical C shaft

A:horizontal; tanθ=h/r.
